projects.title: GAT Interact 2026 - Inter College
projects.description: Built a national inter-college registration portal with a team of three for 5,000+ external participants. Implemented document verification, payment tracking, JWT and OTP authentication, and automated coordinator workflows. Used backend optimisation and Redis caching to support simultaneous registrations across 100+ events without downtime.

projects.title: GAT Interact 2026 - Inter Department
projects.description: Built PRAGNYA for 1,000+ GAT students across 64+ events in 10 domains. Delivered real-time leaderboards, registration workflows, JWT and OTP authentication, and reliable event operations as part of a three-person team.

projects.title: Secure AI-Powered EEG Speech Decoder
projects.description: Built an offline imagined-speech decoder for bilabial versus non-bilabial speech using 64-channel EEG from 15 subjects. Developed artefact rejection, common average reference, 5-band filtering, CSP, LinearSVC, EEG biometric authentication, AES-256-GCM encryption, and a Streamlit replay dashboard. Statistical validation improved balanced accuracy from 50.2% chance to 61.6% (p < 0.0001).

projects.title: GPS-Enhanced V2V Communication
projects.description: Built two decentralised vehicle nodes using Raspberry Pi 5 and NEO-6M GPS modules. Nodes parse NMEA data and exchange 5-field JSON packets over UDP, calculate distance and bearing with the Haversine formula, and provide a Flask/OpenStreetMap dashboard. A simulated PID follower settled from a 10 m to a 5 m gap in 68.6 seconds.
